assertions.statement: 5AN7 names RA95.5-8F in its title and cites Obexer2017 DOI10.1038/nchem.2596. Canonical sequence is distinguished from MHO237 chemical modification and incomplete observed coordinates.
Exact per-residue author numbering is retained; never apply one global offset or equate PDB reference/scaffold annotation to assay identity.
Deposited crystal pH is 4.5; diffraction temperature is100K and reported high resolution is1.10angstrom. These conditions do not identify a reacting solution or the29C activity assay.

Entry prose calls a1,3-diketone CC1 covalently bonded to Lys2083. The coordinate instance is LLK at authorA5001/labelD, and Lys83 is authorA1083. The deposited LLK enone component has no lysine nitrogen and the full struct_conn inventory contains only two MHO peptide connections. No exact typed Lys–LLK bond/order/protonation is supplied; the source-reported covalent adduct is retained separately, not negated.
LLK atoms carry0.75 occupancy; Lys83 alternativesA/B carry0.57/0.43 and Tyr51A/B0.75/0.25. Equal or differing occupancies do not identify joint populations.

Selected Lys83NZ-to-LLKC13 and Tyr51OH-to-LLKO1 distances retain both protein alternatives against the sole deposited ligand instance. They describe coordinates only, not a typed bond, hydrogen-bond assignment or correlated alternate state.

Parent Tyr51OH-to-Tyr180OH separation retains all deposited alternatives and individual atom occupancies. The coordinate audit can be co-retrieved with the existing source-qualified functional panel, without adding causal support to it. No hydrogen bond, invariant network edge, solution population or mutant geometry is assigned.

not_established: No exact physical assay/crystal preparation identity, active fraction, complete mechanism, mutant geometry or productive solution arrangement.
Canonical sequence equality does not erase MHO237 oxidation or unmodeled residues; occupancy is not a kinetic population.
Selected functional-group atoms follow SI FiguresS8/S9; no exhaustive apparatus inventory or generic distance catalogue.
